C0244.title: A Survey of Machine Learning Applications in Spam Filtering by Major Email Providers
C0244.summary: This study surveys how machine learning techniques are applied in the spam filtering systems of major Internet Service Providers (ISPs) such as Gmail, Yahoo, and Outlook.
